public.title: Contains Duplicate
public.description: Return true if any integer appears more than once in values, otherwise false. The array has 0 to 1000 integers, each between -1000000 and 1000000. Equal values need not be adjacent. Aim for linear time.
hints: Use a set to remember distinct values.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A set keeps one copy of each distinct number. If its size differs from the array length, at least one value was repeated. Expected time and space are O(n).
